name: speckit-auto-ai-standalone
description: Markdown to typeset PDF documentation, with no Docker and no setup
author: Mohamed Yassine Reggui

commands.title: Speckit: Discover Models for Custom Provider

speckitStandalone.convertOnSave.description: Convert a markdown file to PDF when it is saved.

speckitStandalone.enrich.description: Use the editor's language model to add a summary, glossary and diagrams. Every claim is checked against your document before it is printed; unsupported ones are dropped.

speckitStandalone.debounceMs.description: How long to wait after a save before converting.

speckitStandalone.autoProcess.description: Process a markdown file when it is saved. Per-project automation is set from the dashboard's Auto transform switch; this is the global gate.

speckitStandalone.includePatterns.description: Glob patterns for files to include in auto-processing.

speckitStandalone.excludePatterns.description: Glob patterns to skip. Tool-generated scaffolding is excluded by default.

speckitStandalone.maxConcurrentProcessin.description: Maximum number of files converted at once.

speckitStandalone.allowRuleBasedFallback.description: Produce a plain PDF when no AI provider is available, instead of reporting an error. Off by default so missing AI is noticed rather than silently producing a document with no glossary or diagrams.

speckitStandalone.enableDebugLogging.description: Verbose logging in the Speckit output channel.

speckitStandalone.preferredModelId.description: Substring matched case-insensitively against the id, family or name of the available models, e.g. "gpt-4o". If it matches, that model is tried first.

speckitStandalone.providerPriority.description: Order in which AI providers are tried. Use custom:<id> to name one entry from speckitStandalone.customModels.

speckitStandalone.customModels.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoints of your own - a local Ollama, a company gateway. Easiest to manage through "Speckit: Manage AI Providers".

scripts.build: npm run compile && npm run build:webview
scripts.package: npm run build && vsce package --target win32-x64
